issue_context.title: Detaching a statically provisioned vSphere PV with folder name in path does not work
issue_context.body:
When user creates a static PV using folder name in path:


```
  vsphereVolume:
    fsType: ext4
    volumePath: '[local-ssd] local-disks/local2.vmdk'
```

on vSAN backed datastore then detach disk does not work because `DiskIsAttached` check fails - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/legacy-cloud-providers/vsphere/vsphere.go#L1007

The code expects folder name to be UUID but it does not and hence it determines disk is *not* attached to the node and hence no detach is ever performed. 

/sig storage

cc @divyenpatel

review_comments: Doesn't kubevols/disk.vmdk require similar canonical volumepath conversion? How is that handled today?
for dynamically provisioned volumes - canonical path is saved in PV and hence gets used for detach and attach.
Can we fail the attach operation if we fail to get canonicalVolumePath and pathFetchErr is no nil?
